questions.stem: A square paper is folded once and a cut is made. When unfolded, what shape is obtained?
questions.visual_svg: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 300 180" width="300" height="180" style="font-family:Arial,sans-serif"><rect x="50" y="30" width="200" height="120" fill="#E8F4FD" stroke="#2196F3" stroke-width="2.5" rx="2"/></svg>

hint.level_0: Track two things: how many LAYERS the folds make, and where the cut goes through them.
hint.level_1: Each fold doubles the layers: 1 fold = 2 layers, 2 folds = 4 layers. One cut goes through every layer.
hint.level_2: Unfold step by step in your head — each layer shows its own copy of the cut. How many copies / what shape? = ?

hint.level_0: Sort the numbers first: what was PAID in total (cost price) and what was RECEIVED (selling price)?
hint.level_1: Profit = selling price − total cost. Loss = total cost − selling price.
